input.command: ls -la && grep -rIl -i "Start your free trial\|Commencez votre essai\|No credit card needed\|Pas de carte" . 2>/dev/null | head -50
input.description: List working directory and search for the strings

content.text:
I couldn't find the signup page or the French copy in this directory. `/private/tmp/owbench-runs` holds only four small `mcp-*.json` files, and a search for the English and French strings found nothing. So I checked the two strings you gave me on their own.

- **"Start your free trial" → "Commencez votre essai gratuit"**: Correct and natural. "Démarrez votre essai gratuit" is an equally good alternative if you want a more active tone.
- **"No credit card needed" → "Pas de carte de crédit nécessaire"**: Correct and idiomatic. French product UIs often say "Aucune carte bancaire requise" instead, so pick whichever matches your other copy.

If you send the file path, or paste the full French copy, I'll review the whole page for accuracy, tone, and consistency with these strings.
